strings.Pomôžu s termínmi, právnou orientáciou,: They help with deadlines, legal information, calculations, and loyalty cards.
strings.Majte termíny, doklady, vozidlá, poisten: Keep deadlines, IDs, vehicles, insurance, and documents clearly organized in one place.
strings.Zrozumiteľné informácie o cestnej premáv: Clear information about road traffic, offences, and penalties with references to legislation.
strings.Informačná aplikácia. Nenahrádza právne: Informational app. It does not replace legal advice.
strings.Klasická kalkulačka a praktické výpočty: A classic calculator with practical percentage, discount, and savings calculations plus a clear history.
strings.Majte vernostné karty vždy poruke. Prida: Keep loyalty cards close at hand. Add them by scanning, from an image, or manually, find them quickly, and sync with iCloud.
strings.Dôležité funkcie nájdete bez zbytočného: Find important features without unnecessary searching.
strings.Jasné texty, zrozumiteľné stavy a prehľa: Clear text, understandable states, and straightforward controls.
strings.Aplikácie sú navrhnuté tak, aby údaje zo: Apps are designed so data stays on the device or in the user's Apple services whenever possible.
strings.Aplikácie vyvíjame postupne a každú verz: We develop apps iteratively and review every version before release.
Privacy is part of the product.
strings.Spôsob práce s údajmi závisí od konkrétn: How data is handled depends on the specific app and enabled features. Much of the data stays on the device or, when sync is enabled, is stored through Apple services.
strings.Vyberte aplikáciu a stručne nám napíšte,: Choose an app and briefly tell us what you need help with. Do not send passwords, photos of IDs, full card numbers, barcodes, or QR codes.
strings.Stručne opíšte svoju otázku alebo problé: Briefly describe your question or problem…

strings.Na bežné otázky, návrhy a diskusiu. Nepo: For general questions, suggestions, and discussion. Do not send personal or sensitive data.
strings.Spoločné pravidlá pre vzhľad, nastavenia: Shared rules for appearance, settings, navigation, accessibility, privacy, and quality help our apps feel consistent.
